VR.title: Snap Acquires AR Startup Illumix to Boost Next-gen ‘Specs’ Glasses
VR.summary: Snap has acquired AR startup Illumix to enhance its next-generation smart glasses, expanding beyond gaming into broader augmented reality applications.

VR.title: Valve Confirms Summer Release Window for Steam Frame and Steam Machine
VR.summary: Valve has confirmed a summer release for its standalone VR headset Steam Frame and the Steam Machine console, following delays due to component shortages.

VR.title: Quest 3 Headsets Are Heading To The International Space Station
VR.summary: Two Quest 3 headsets will be sent to the International Space Station to assist astronauts in training for spacewalks, marking a significant collaboration with the ESA.

VR.title: Meta is Spinning out ‘Supernatural’ a Mere 3 Years After $400M Acquisition
VR.summary: Meta has spun out its VR fitness app Supernatural into an independent company, allowing for fresh content and a renewed focus on user engagement.

VR.summary: X-Plane 12 and iRacing are now playable in VR on Apple Vision Pro, offering immersive experiences streamed from PCs with physical accessories integration.

VR.title: CleanSheet Soccer 2 Heads To PlayStation VR2 Next Week
VR.summary: CleanSheet Soccer 2 launches on PlayStation VR2 next week, featuring a complete redesign and eliminating subscription fees from its predecessor.

AI.title: Amazon develops a warehouse robot that workers can speak to

AI.summary: Tech leaders have united to call for stricter regulations on AI technologies to prevent their use in developing biological weapons.

AI.summary: New York lawmakers have passed a one-year ban on new large data centers, aiming to assess their environmental impact.

NFL.summary: Head coach Sean Payton praised new Broncos receiver Jaylen Waddle for quickly adapting to the team's offensive strategies during OTAs.
